text: A tiny floating island at night, a farm plot with tomatoes and a bunny-like creature. It says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Day 2, 10 coins. Let me tap the tomatoes.
Harvest gave +3 coins and 3 XP. Night turned into day 3. Now 'Tap the farm to sow'. A bottom panel shows Sow / Water / Harvest, 1 sec each. Tapping the farm.
Watered, crops are growing (2s left). The bunny is called a Momo. Now it asks me to tap a Momo. Cute!
Days are only 30 seconds, it's night again. A Momo panel opened with 'Free time' and Assign. Tutorial says tap the pencil to pick tiles this Momo looks after.
Assigned the farm tile to Momo, marked '1'. Momo is now 'Working at Farm'. The other tiles are empty grass, so I'll confirm with the checkmark.
Momo works the farm on its own now - 19 coins, +9/min. A mail bubble popped up over Momo and the Mailbox has a red dot. Let me open the mailbox.
Aww, a letter from Momo proposing to widen the field. Very charming. Income is climbing fast (+18/min). Tapping 'Let's research it'.

Research tree with tabs: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 coins, and there's a button 'Build a research lab'. So I need a lab to make the flasks. Tapping it.
A build menu: Farm 10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. I'm Lv1 50/95 so the lab is locked. I have 40 coins - buying a second farm should speed everything up.
The second farm is being built on the right tile (it picked the spot itself). 2 sec build. There's a new mail again. Opening it.
Level 2! Fireworks. Research lab and Lumberyard unlocked. The second farm is ripe and Momo is on the first one, so I'll harvest the second myself.
Harvested farm 2 - 63 coins. Now I want to build the research lab. I'll tap the empty grass on the left to see if a build menu comes up.
Tapping grass opens the build menu. Research lab 40, Lumberyard 80 (red - can't afford). Building the research lab here on the left tile.
Lab is under construction. New hint: 'Tap the glowing sea to grow the island' - there's a dashed outline in the water, seems to cost 30. I have 35. Let's grow!

The island grew a new tile in the bottom-right with a little bush. Lab is done and Momo walked to it on its own. A tip explains empty tiles build things and demolishing returns half. 17 coins left. Got it.
A flask counter '1' appeared under the day - the lab made a research note. One Momo is juggling two farms and the lab. I wonder if I can hire a second Momo. Checking Hire.
Hiring another Momo costs 90, I have 32. Saving up. Meanwhile I'll help by harvesting the ripe right farm myself.
Oops, Momo had already moved to that farm so I tapped Momo instead. It shows Momo's route numbered 1,2,3 over the farms and the lab - it already looks after everything. Fine. 2 flasks now.
Third letter: compost for bigger harvests. I now have 3 flasks and Research has a red dot - Field expansion should be affordable. Accepting this letter, then researching.
Field expansion researching, 20 seconds. Spent 3 flasks + 20 coins. Now I'm curious what 'Next: City 0/4' in the top-left means. Closing research and tapping it.

Level 3, Mine unlocked! The Status panel shows my island 'Momonium - a small island, a big tomorrow'. To become a City I need Land 5/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 0/3, Value 44/1.5K. Now I have a clear goal: more land, more Momos, more research.

Research levels already 1/3 - Field expansion finished. 63 coins. I think a second Momo (90) is the best buy since one Momo runs three buildings. Closing panels and helping harvest the ripe right farm while I save.
Harvest now gives +6 instead of +3 - the field expansion doubled it, nice payoff! 93 coins, +66/min. Hiring a second Momo now.

Hired 'Mochi'! Mochi went straight to the research lab, so the first Momo can focus on farms. Love that each has a name. 27 coins. Next plan: buy the 40 sea tile and build a mine. Waiting a few seconds.
With Mochi on the lab, flasks jumped to 6 and income is +102/min. Research has a red dot again - checking what I can unlock.

Field expansion can be levelled up (Lv1/5): 4 flasks + 38 coins for another +1 crop. Watering efficiency and Bigger harvests are also lighting up. Field expansion doubled my income last time so I'll take Lv2.

Bought the land, the island is shaped like an L now, and a new glowing tile appeared next to it. A Momo at the lab has a '...' thought bubble. 69 coins. Tapping the empty middle tile to build a Mine (unlocked at Lv3).

Mine needs 120 coins + 10 Wood - so I need wood first, i.e. a Lumberyard (80). I have 87. Also a toast: Field expansion Lv2 went from Crops +1 to +1.25, a much smaller bump than Lv1. Building the Lumberyard.
Lumberyard under construction in the middle. 'Lumberyard 0/1' - probably needs a Momo to work it. Let me wait and see if one of my two Momos goes there by itself.
The farm Momo moved over to the lumberyard (Fell/Replant). Now both farms are ripe with nobody tending them - I'll harvest them myself.
Wood counter appeared (2 logs) next to 12 flasks. Momos keep hopping between buildings. Research dot is on - going to spend flasks on Bigger harvests.
Bigger harvests: 8 flasks + 60 coins, 2 minutes, Crops +1 (full +1, better than Field expansion Lv3's tiny bump). Starting it; the mine can wait a bit.
Only one research at a time ('Another research is running'). Both farms are ripe again and both Momos are at the lab/lumberyard. Closing and harvesting both farms by hand.
Beautiful sunset. 99 coins, 8 wood. The right farm still looks ripe and the Harvest button is lit - trying the button directly this time.
Harvest button works from the bottom bar. 110 coins and exactly 10 wood - nearly enough for the mine (120 + 10 wood). Reading the new mail while coins tick up.
Level 4 (silently this time?). Letter about a tree nursery - accepting. 130 coins, 12 wood: time to build the mine on the empty tile with the bush.
Mine is going up (7 sec) on the bottom-right tile. Now I have 5 buildings and only 2 Momos - they can't keep up. Checking what a third Momo costs.
Third Momo costs 145 now (price went up from 90). The mine is built - a cute cave with a minecart. Both farms are ripe and unattended again, so I'm the farmer. Harvesting.
Harvested both; a stone counter appeared too (1 stone) so somebody's been to the mine. Fields are bare - sowing them myself so they don't sit idle.
Bigger harvests is almost done (green bar). 21 flasks piling up but I can only run one research at a time - that feels like a bottleneck. Peeking at the Mine tab.

Mine research needs 'Mine mastery Lv2' first - locked. But 'Next: City' just became 1/4, so Bigger harvests must have finished (research levels 3/3). Going back to Farm tab to start Watering efficiency.
Bigger harvests done (badge 1), Greenhouse and Seed selection unlocked. Started Watering efficiency. 159 coins - enough for that third Momo (145) right as time runs out. Fun loop!
Research ate 40 coins so I'm at 142, 3 short of the 145 Momo. Waiting a few seconds then hiring.
Hired 'Pomu', who went straight to the mine. Next: City is 2/4 now. Three Momos, 5 buildings, +103/min. Would happily keep going.
